engine: georinex GPS-only L1 SPP on rover_ublox.obs
data_mode: FULLY REAL: real GNSS positions + real IMU + real wheel odometry + cm truth

config.degraded_def: real GNSS fix with <=5 satellites (poor geometry)
config.p_degraded_source: nsat proxy (P=0 at nsat>=5, P=1 at nsat<=2)

_methodology: FULLY REAL GNSS via georinex GPS-only L1 SPP on rover_ublox.obs. Errors are REAL urban multipath/NLOS, not synthetic.
The EKF predicts at 10 Hz on real IMU + wheel-odometry and updates on real fixes.
Degradation is defined by REAL satellite geometry (<=5 sats), not injected windows.
P(DEGRADED) source: nsat proxy (P=0 at nsat>=5, P=1 at nsat<=2).
Chi-squared innovation gate (99.9%, 2-DOF): outlier fixes are soft-rejected even at P=0.
